entities.summary: Arvid Wittenberg or Arvid Wirtenberg von Debern, was a Swedish count, field marshal and privy councillor. Born in Porvoo, Finland, he died imprisoned in Zamość, Poland, 7 September 1657. Arvid Wittenberg preferred to call himself by the original Wittenberg family name, which was Wirtenberg von Debern.
